items.title: Puppet报告处理反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 持有CA签发代理证书者可向报告处理接口PUT提交恶意rich-data，以服务用户权限执行任意代码
items.affected: puppet puppet >=8.0.0 <8.22.2; puppet puppet >=9.0.0 <9.1.3
items.action_zh: 升级至8.22.2或9.1.3；过渡期限制代理证书签发与报告来源
items.repro_note: 需CA签发的代理证书；PUT提交含恶意rich-data类型的报告
items.impact_scope: 内网DevOps配置管理核心，可控制全部节点
items.description: Deserialization of untrusted data in the report-processing code of Puppet, as used by Puppet Server, in the affected releases, allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute arbitrary code on the Puppet Server as its service user by submitting a report containing a crafted rich-data type via PUT request. Where the certificate authority autosigns requests without strong verification, an unauthenticated network attacker can obtain such a certificate.

items.title: 53AIHub未授权初始化接口致接管
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者调用POST /api/init重初始化实例，重置密码并获取令牌接管管理员账户
items.action_zh: 升级至0.5.5；临时禁止/api/init对外访问
items.repro_note: 未授权POST /api/init重新走初始化流程
items.impact_scope: AI应用门户，暴露公网即被完全接管
items.description: 53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to reinitialize installed instances by calling the public POST /api/init endpoint. Attackers can reset an existing account's password, assign the top creator role, and obtain an access token to take over accounts and use admin-only API routes.

items.title: ZoneMinder配置项命令注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 可改监控选项者将ZM_PATH_FFMPEG设为含命令值，触发帧提取exec以Web用户执行命令
items.action_zh: 升级修复版本；限制选项修改权限并校验该参数
items.repro_note: 将ZM_PATH_FFMPEG改为含命令值，请求帧提取触发exec
items.impact_scope: 视频监控平台，泄露摄像头与录像
items.description: An attacker can set ZM_PATH_FFMPEG to a command-bearing value and trigger an exec() sink in web/views/image.php or web/includes/Event.php by requesting frame extraction. This permits arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the web server user and can expose private camera feeds, recordings, and database data or establish persistence.

items.title: BISHENG硬编码JWT密钥致认证绕过
items.title_zh: BISHENG硬编码JWT密钥致认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者用内置硬编码jwt_secret伪造管理员令牌，调用管理API接管平台
items.action_zh: 升级至3.0.0；轮换jwt_secret并校验令牌
items.repro_note: 用默认jwt_secret签发管理员JWT访问管理接口
items.impact_scope: LLM应用平台，含知识库与密钥数据
items.description: BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to impersonate administrators by abusing a hard-coded default jwt_secret used by AuthJwt. Attackers can forge an HS256 token offline naming user_id 1 with the admin role, send it as access_token_cookie, and gain full administrative access to users, workspaces, knowledge bases and workflows.

items.title: Atomic Server邀请接口缺失认证
items.title_zh: Atomic Server邀请接口缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 未认证攻击者调用邀请跳转接口并传入自控公钥即可创建Agent,获得整个Drive写权限
items.action_zh: 关注官方修复版本并升级;临时限制邀请接口外部访问
items.repro_note: 未认证调用邀请跳转接口,传入自控公钥即可注册Agent
items.impact_scope: 内部无头CMS/实时数据库,数据可被篡改
items.description: Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. construct_invite_redirect in server/src/plugins/invite.rs discards the redeemer identity, so an unauthenticated request containing an attacker-controlled public-key can create a new Agent and grant it write access to the entire Drive.

items.title: WeGIA支付接口缺失授权可篡改账单
items.title_zh: WeGIA支付接口缺失授权可篡改账单
items.summary_zh: 未认证请求者提交支付ID、日期与金额即可将任意账单标记为已付,造成财务记录被篡改
items.action_zh: 升级至官方修复版本;临时对支付接口强制会话校验
items.repro_note: 未认证直接向支付接口提交支付ID、日期与实付金额参数
items.impact_scope: 公益机构管理系统,内网财务数据
items.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/atualiza_pagamentos.php performs payment-status database updates without checking whether the requester has an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester can supply a payment identifier, payment date, and paid value to mark arbitrary payment records as paid or otherwise modify payment information, causing financial record corruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

items.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/cadastro_cobranca.php creates billing records without checking for an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies valid billing parameters can create arbitrary billing entries, enabling financial data manipulation and operational disruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

items.impact_scope: 公益机构管理系统,会员档案数据
items.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/processa_edicao_socio.php updates member information without validating an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies a target member identifier and replacement member fields can modify arbitrary member records, corrupt personal information, and cause loss of data integrity. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

items.description: WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.6, web/html/socio/sistema/cadastro_cobrancas_geracao.php performs privileged charge-generation operations without checking for an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester who supplies valid charge-generation parameters can create arbitrary charge records, enabling financial record manipulation and large-scale billing corruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.6.

items.title: arize-phoenix CWE-134
items.description: - Summary A format string injection vulnerability in the applyChatTemplate GraphQL endpoint allows an attacker to read server-side environment variables, cryptographic secrets, and internal module attributes directly from the API response. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to extract PHOENIX_SECRET, the master key used to sign all JWTs and derive the Fernet encryption key protecting stored credentials (LLM API keys, OAuth tokens).
